caption: The drawing displays a bonnet predominantly colored in two shades: the exterior and most visible part of the bonnet is dark blue, while the inner section and the front brim feature a quilted pattern in light pink. Two long pink ribbons extend from the bottom front edges of the bonnet. The bonnet is drawn with detailed shading to show dimensions and texture. Additionally, there are two small, simple outline sketches of the same bonnet on the lower right side of the page, one viewed from the front and the other from the back, both without color, showing only basic structural details. The drawing is set on a plain, light beige background with some subtle shading and gradient effects near the edges of the page.
title: Bonnet
